sets.relationshipLabel: object and the structural feature it has
sets.explanation: An orb web's hub and a leaf's vein are both the central, branching feature that gives the object its structure, not something it does or becomes.

sets.relationshipLabel: organ and the action it exists to perform
sets.explanation: A spinneret exists to spin silk and a fang exists to inject venom — each organ is defined by the single act it was built for.

sets.relationshipLabel: one thing transforming into another through a process
sets.explanation: Mist condenses into dew and a grub metamorphoses into a beetle — two very different domains, same shape of transformation.

sets.relationshipLabel: start and end of a span
sets.explanation: Sunrise opens a day as sunset closes it, and weaving begins a fabric's life as tearing ends it — the same start-to-finish shape at wildly different scales.

glossary.definition: A small body part near the tail end of a spider that silk comes out of

definitions.definition: A round, spiral spiderweb spun between anchor points to catch flying insects.
The center point of a web where the threads all meet and the spider often waits.
The flat green part of a plant that catches sunlight to make food.
One of the thin branching lines running through a leaf that carry water and nutrients.
The small organ on a spider's body that silk comes out of.
To twist and pull out silk or thread to make a strand.
A sharp pointed tooth some animals use to bite and deliver venom.
To force a liquid, like venom, into something through a sharp point.
A light haze of tiny water droplets floating in the air.
Small drops of water that form on cool surfaces overnight.
A soft, worm-like young stage of certain insects before they grow up.
A hard-shelled insect with wings tucked under a stiff outer casing.
The moment the sun comes up and a new day begins.
The moment the sun goes down and the day comes to a close.
To cross threads over and under each other to make cloth or a web.
To rip something apart by pulling, breaking its threads or fibers.
